pause: update "task_dispatch_cycles" set "state" = $1, "codex_thread_id" = $2, "turn_id" = $3, "last_heartbeat_at" = $4, "paused_at" = $5, "updated_at" = $6 where (("task_dispatch_cycles"."id" = $7 and "task_dispatch_cycles"."operation_id" = $8 and "task_dispatch_cycles"."lease_owner" = $9 and "task_dispatch_cycles"."fencing_token" = $10 and "task_dispatch_cycles"."lease_expires_at" > $11) and "task_dispatch_cycles"."state" in ($12, $13)) returning "id", "owner_id", "chat_id", "operation_id", "operation_kind", "state", "fifo_created_at", "requested_task_worker_id", "selected_task_worker_id", "task_worker_revision", "continuity_family", "model_configuration", "model_route_id", "provider_account_id", "physical_worker_id", "worktree_id", "codex_thread_id", "turn_id", "lease_owner", "lease_expires_at", "last_heartbeat_at", "fencing_token", "attempt_count", "eligibility_code", "queued_at", "claimed_at", "started_at", "paused_at", "completed_at", "created_at", "updated_at"
unstarted: update "task_dispatch_cycles" set "state" = $1, "codex_thread_id" = $2, "turn_id" = $3, "last_heartbeat_at" = $4, "fencing_token" = "task_dispatch_cycles"."fencing_token" + 1, "paused_at" = $5, "updated_at" = $6 where (("task_dispatch_cycles"."id" = $7 and "task_dispatch_cycles"."operation_id" = $8 and "task_dispatch_cycles"."lease_owner" = $9 and "task_dispatch_cycles"."fencing_token" = $10 and "task_dispatch_cycles"."lease_expires_at" > $11) and "task_dispatch_cycles"."state" = $12 and "task_dispatch_cycles"."started_at" is null) returning "id", "owner_id", "chat_id", "operation_id", "operation_kind", "state", "fifo_created_at", "requested_task_worker_id", "selected_task_worker_id", "task_worker_revision", "continuity_family", "model_configuration", "model_route_id", "provider_account_id", "physical_worker_id", "worktree_id", "codex_thread_id", "turn_id", "lease_owner", "lease_expires_at", "last_heartbeat_at", "fencing_token", "attempt_count", "eligibility_code", "queued_at", "claimed_at", "started_at", "paused_at", "completed_at", "created_at", "updated_at"
heartbeat: update "task_dispatch_cycles" set "lease_expires_at" = $1, "last_heartbeat_at" = $2, "updated_at" = $3 where (("task_dispatch_cycles"."id" = $4 and "task_dispatch_cycles"."operation_id" = $5 and "task_dispatch_cycles"."lease_owner" = $6 and "task_dispatch_cycles"."fencing_token" = $7 and "task_dispatch_cycles"."lease_expires_at" > $8) and "task_dispatch_cycles"."state" in ($9, $10)) returning "id"
settle: update "task_dispatch_cycles" set "state" = $1, "completed_at" = $2, "updated_at" = $3 where (("task_dispatch_cycles"."id" = $4 and "task_dispatch_cycles"."operation_id" = $5 and "task_dispatch_cycles"."lease_owner" = $6 and "task_dispatch_cycles"."fencing_token" = $7 and "task_dispatch_cycles"."lease_expires_at" > $8) and "task_dispatch_cycles"."state" in ($9, $10, $11)) returning "id", "owner_id", "chat_id", "operation_id", "operation_kind", "state", "fifo_created_at", "requested_task_worker_id", "selected_task_worker_id", "task_worker_revision", "continuity_family", "model_configuration", "model_route_id", "provider_account_id", "physical_worker_id", "worktree_id", "codex_thread_id", "turn_id", "lease_owner", "lease_expires_at", "last_heartbeat_at", "fencing_token", "attempt_count", "eligibility_code", "queued_at", "claimed_at", "started_at", "paused_at", "completed_at", "created_at", "updated_at"
